subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to share the details of our upcoming trip to Paris. We have booked flights for April 15th and will be staying at the Marriott Champs Elysees Hotel. Our itinerary includes visits to the Louvre Museum, Eiffel Tower, and a day trip to Versailles. Please review the attached itinerary for more information. Looking forward to exploring Paris together! Best regards, [Your Name]
